top_signals.title: Japanese Stocks Signal Confidence Over Faster BOJ ETF Sales
top_signals.summary: Japanese equities shrugged off the Bank of Japan’s surprise move to accelerate selling of its massive holdings of exchange-traded funds, as investors showed confidence in the market’s ability to absorb the extra supply.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Estimated $6.3 Billion Hacked in Binance Security Breach
top_signals.summary: Binance, the world’s largest crypto exchange, said $6.3 billion of funds have been impacted in what the industry is describing as crypto’s biggest-ever hack. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
